source_snapshot.procedure: Test connection between BMC and PDB.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC can successfully communicate with I2C devices on PDB.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_I2C_bus9; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes generic BMC i2cdetect/i2cget plus operator inspection, without proving PDB assembly, safe PMBus registers or power-state stability.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for PDB topology/assembly/device oracle, read-safe transactions, prohibited controls, physical evidence, rail interlocks and recovery.

old_problem: Generic probing on a live PDB management bus may touch PMBus control, hot-swap, protection, EEPROM or clear-on-read registers. ACKs do not identify the intended PDB revision or prove the correct BMC I2C-9 path, and software alone cannot prove the physical connection.
disposition_reason: The review can define a safe acceptance model without guessing OEM data: bind the exact PDB assembly/topology and a signed read-only identity allowlist, explicitly prohibit raw discovery and all state-changing or clear-on-read operations, require operator physical proof, and correlate reads with stable rail/protection health. Exact devices/registers and vendor command are gated Project Configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2160, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2161 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00048-V002 / 09359d636b8c7f56 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind PDB part number, serial and revision plus logical I2C-9 to the exact BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel and PDB connector.
Bind only read-safe manufacturer/identity registers and expected values; classify and prohibit clear-on-read status, PMBus control, hot-swap, protection and EEPROM operations.
Operator verifies/photographs the physical connection and approved service/load state; software correlates target-bound identity with synchronized rail/protection and bus health.
Prefer an approved BMC PDB inventory interface. Raw i2cdetect or unknown i2cget is prohibited until every transaction is explicitly allowlisted.
Stop on rail excursion, protection/hot-swap event, timeout, stuck bus, unexpected device or BMC/PDB instability; no blind reset/retry.
No BMC/PDB query, physical manipulation, power change, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Power-safe BMC I2C-9 to PDB physical and identity validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the BMC I2C-9 path is physically connected to the intended PDB assembly and can safely identify every required PDB management device without altering rail, hot-swap, protection or EEPROM state.
required_package: PDB PN/serial/revision and BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel/connector map
PDB device/address/read-safe identity register/value allowlist and explicit prohibited-operation list
Vendor-approved BMC/PDB inventory or non-destructive read method
Approved physical service/load state, operator inspection/photos and synchronized power monitoring
Bus/rail/protection abort thresholds and vendor recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Operator verifies the PDB assembly and connection in the approved stable-load state. Use only the approved BMC/PDB inventory or explicitly allowlisted non-clear-on-read identity queries on the mapped I2C-9 channel; capture complete responses plus synchronized rail/protection and bus health. Do not run a generic scan.
test_case.expected_result: Physical evidence matches the intended PDB assembly/path; every required device returns the approved identity, all rails/protection/hot-swap and BMC states remain stable, and no missing/unexpected response or bus fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical assembly/path proof, full identity-oracle reconciliation and stable power/bus health. FAIL on wrong assembly/path, missing/mismatched/unexpected device, rail/protection event or bus/BMC/PDB fault. Missing signed topology/allowlist/method is runtime BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until PDB assembly/topology, transaction allowlist/prohibitions, load state, thresholds and recovery are signed.
Operator handles physical work and monitors power state.
No generic scan, unknown or clear-on-read register, PMBus/hot-swap/protection/EEPROM write, blind reset or automatic retry.
Stop immediately on rail excursion, protection event, timeout, stuck bus, error storm or management instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval, PDB PN/serial/revision and connection photos
BMC I2C-9 controller/mux/channel/PDB connector map and service/load state
Approved identity register/value allowlist and prohibited-operation list
Exact method and complete PDB identity response reconciliation
Synchronized pre/during/post rails, protection/hot-swap and BMC/I2C error evidence
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on any power or bus anomaly. Follow only the vendor-approved PDB/BMC recovery while maintaining the authorized power state; do not issue raw writes, rescan or blindly reset. Quarantine and escalate if rails, protection or management state cannot be restored.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure, Criteria and bundle consistently target BMC I2C-9 communication with the PDB.

blocked.reason: Purpose and power-safe validation pattern are complete; exact PDB topology, identities and vendor method are runtime project bindings behind a closed gate.
